name: Selecting a different storage variant updates displayed info

preconditions.note: Skip if product has no storage variants

steps.script: (() => { const storageEl = document.querySelectorAll('[class*="storage"], [class*="variant"] button, [class*="variant"] a, .pdp [class*="chip"]'); return { hasOptions: storageEl.length > 0, count: storageEl.length }; })()

steps.description: Click a storage variant option if available
steps.snapshotHint: Look for storage size options like '128GB', '256GB' etc. Skip if none found.

businessContext: Storage variants show different price points — essential for customers comparing capacities
